meta.title: Bing daily wallpaper
meta.description: Daily Bing wallpaper with image-derived colours, ten HCT styles, visibility up to 100%, and automatic light/dark appearance. Open Settings → Bing daily wallpaper. Offers Bing China and international (US) sources, keeps the last image when updates fail, and offers system, schedule and fixed appearance modes. Browser-local controls; appearance changes use DSH’s shared theme preference. Images remain subject to Bing and photographer rights.

title: Bing daily wallpaper
sourceFailed: Could not switch sources. The previous source’s wallpaper is still shown; check your connection and retry.
waiting: Wallpaper paused or not yet loaded
paused: Wallpaper and dynamic theme are paused
firstFetchFailed: Wallpaper could not be loaded. Check your connection and retry.
fetchFailed: Update failed. The previous wallpaper is kept; check your connection and retry.
stale: Bing is unavailable. Showing the last successful wallpaper.
sameTime: Light and dark times must be different.
